evidence.finding: Group 70 bit 64 records whether a linetype was referenced during the last edit; Autodesk says readers may ignore it and writers need not set it. The implementation therefore treats this bit as advisory while preserving the exact selected source audit and verifying the writer's canonical flags-0 output.
